About this item

  • 【2-in-1 Mopping and Vacuuming】 The ROPVACNIC Robot S1 integrates advanced electronically controlled mopping technology, significantly enhancing both cleaning efficiency and effectiveness, which makes your floors remain free from footprints, dirt, and dust throughout the day. It features an upgraded high-capacity water tank with a four-stage personalized water adjustment system, enabling it to address various stains across different settings according to user requirements.
  • 【Comprehensive Intelligent Control】 Multiple Cleaning Modes, combined with personalized settings, allow you to easily accomplish various household cleaning tasks with zero effort from your smartphone. Moreover, by voice commands, you can start your cleaning while kicking back and relaxing (compatible with Alexa or Google Assistant). Enjoy an utterly hands-free cleaning experience.
  • 【5200Pa Powerful Suction】A 3-point cleaning system coupled with strong suction ensures your floors are free from all dirt, dust, and crumbs for a thorough, superior clean. The highly passable compact design combined with 3-level suction facilitates cleaning in hard-to-reach areas where you can't, making it suitable for a wide range of surfaces from wood, and hard floors to low pile carpets.
  • 【Smarter High Automation & Self-Recharge】 The robot aspiradora is equipped with an advanced high-coverage sensing system and multiple algorithmic data points, enabling autonomous completion of cleaning tasks—from scheduled starting, detecting obstacles, adjusting direction, and switching modes, to automatically returning to recharge. This hassle-free operation ensures a clean home when you return.
  • 【Engineered for Pet Owner】 The exclusive no-entanglement design negates the need for your dirty hands to clean up tangled dog or cat hair, unlike traditional roller brushes. Its dual rotating electric side brushes sweep and collect hidden pet hair more efficiently throughout the house, saving you the hassle.

robot vacuum and mop

Intelligent Self-charging

No more worrying about the robot running out of power, ROBVACNIC S1 will intelligently run itself back to the base to charge when it's below 20%.

Clean Hard-to-reach Area

Only 2.99" in height and 12" in diameter, ROPVACNIC S1 can easily slips under and around the furniture to clean the hidden areas where you can't.

Larger and Longer Lasting

Featuring a spacious onboard dustbin and powered by a 4400mAh long-lasting battery, ROPVACNIC Robot S1 delivers hassle-free cleaning for large homes.

What's in the Package

Robot Vacuum Cleaner, Mop Pad Holder, Charging Base, Power adapter, Water Tank, Mopping Cloth, HEPA filter, Side brushes, Cleaning brush, User manual

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Zero Regrets
I just want to say that this robotic vacuum has genuinely been a game changer for me. I recently moved into a house with roommates, boy roommates, I should add, so the house can get pretty messy. I am also a clean freak, especially when it comes to my bedroom, and I like to make sure it stays clean at all times. I even purchased a welcome mat specifically for my room so I could separate my space from the rest of the house and take my shoes on and off at the mat. I purchased this robot because I knew that vacuuming and mopping regularly would be time-consuming with my schedule, and I am so glad I bought it. I have it scheduled to run every day at 3:00 p.m., and it works like a charm. I am honestly astonished by how much it picks up. I have found dead bugs and even a cockroach in the vacuum trap that I probably would never have noticed or found myself. The mop feature is wonderful as well. It makes me feel so much cleaner when walking around my room, and I have a sense of ease knowing that I am not tracking dirt and grime everywhere. I have virtually zero complaints. I did run into one issue where the vacuum started making a squeaking sound after I removed the mop attachment. I contacted Amazon support, but they were unable to resolve it because they did not realize the mop attachment might be connected to the issue. My guess was that the mop helped reduce the friction and prevented the squeaking. Thankfully, I figured it out on my own because I was worried I might need to purchase WD-40 or something similar. I am usually a huge proponent of returning Amazon products when they do not meet my expectations, but with this particular product, I refused to return it when Amazon offered because I truly love the vacuum. The only area for improvement I could suggest would be adding a designated place for a compatible cleaning solution or providing clearer guidance on whether customers can add an approved solution to the mop water. Mopping with water alone sometimes feels like it may just move the dirt around rather than fully cleaning the floor. I usually prefer having some type of cleaning product involved, although this may have already been addressed in the user manual and I may have overlooked it. Other than that, I am incredibly satisfied with my purchase. I have recommended the vacuum to my roommates, shown it off to them, and they have been impressed by it as well. I feel so much better having this vacuum and would gladly recommend it to anyone.

About this Item

  • 【2-in-1 Mopping and Vacuuming】 The ROPVACNIC Robot S1 integrates advanced electronically controlled mopping technology, significantly enhancing both cleaning efficiency and effectiveness, which makes your floors remain free from footprints, dirt, and dust throughout the day. It features an upgraded high-capacity water tank with a four-stage personalized water adjustment system, enabling it to address various stains across different settings according to user requirements.
  • 【Comprehensive Intelligent Control】 Multiple Cleaning Modes, combined with personalized settings, allow you to easily accomplish various household cleaning tasks with zero effort from your smartphone. Moreover, by voice commands, you can start your cleaning while kicking back and relaxing (compatible with Alexa or Google Assistant). Enjoy an utterly hands-free cleaning experience.
  • 【5200Pa Powerful Suction】A 3-point cleaning system coupled with strong suction ensures your floors are free from all dirt, dust, and crumbs for a thorough, superior clean. The highly passable compact design combined with 3-level suction facilitates cleaning in hard-to-reach areas where you can't, making it suitable for a wide range of surfaces from wood, and hard floors to low pile carpets.
  • 【Smarter High Automation & Self-Recharge】 The robot aspiradora is equipped with an advanced high-coverage sensing system and multiple algorithmic data points, enabling autonomous completion of cleaning tasks—from scheduled starting, detecting obstacles, adjusting direction, and switching modes, to automatically returning to recharge. This hassle-free operation ensures a clean home when you return.
  • 【Engineered for Pet Owner】 The exclusive no-entanglement design negates the need for your dirty hands to clean up tangled dog or cat hair, unlike traditional roller brushes. Its dual rotating electric side brushes sweep and collect hidden pet hair more efficiently throughout the house, saving you the hassle.
